$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskRoot = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/ci-edit-loop-windows'
$expectedHead = '0ca889b9e3c3b6b60dd52002f737d17af56082d8'
$expectedTree = '71c407d226dc6fc80858506d4eb1831729cbd97b'
Set-Location -LiteralPath $taskRoot
$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/fix-mutation-retry-truth/target'
$env:CARGO_BUILD_JOBS = '1'
$env:CARGO_TERM_COLOR = 'never'
$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES = "$taskRoot/crates/app/config/bubbles.toml"
if (Test-Path Env:RUST_TEST_THREADS) { throw 'Unexpected test concurrency override' }
if (Test-Path Env:QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR) { throw 'Unexpected inspector override' }
"FULL_LOOP_START_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
"WRAPPER_PID=$PID"
"HEAD=$expectedHead"
"SOURCE_TREE=$expectedTree"
'BASE=9ff57501249f51d8f75c21f52094ec3dc3c39af2'
"CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
"CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=$env:CARGO_BUILD_JOBS"
"QUANTICK_BUBBLES=$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES"
"BUBBLES_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES).Hash)"
"CARGO_LOCK_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath Cargo.lock).Hash)"
"TOOLCHAIN_FILE_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath rust-toolchain.toml).Hash)"
'EVIDENCE_CLASS=Fresh changed-base correctness verification; not timing/calibration'
cargo --version
rustc --version
$frozen = @('docs/quality/outside-score-rubric.md', 'docs/quality/quantick-score-rubric.md', 'tools/outside_score/measure.py', '.claude/skills/outside-score/SKILL.md', '.claude/skills/quantick-score/SKILL.md', '.agents/skills/outside-score/SKILL.md', '.agents/skills/quantick-score/SKILL.md')
foreach ($taskPath in $frozen) {
    $initialBlob = git rev-parse "eb7bb039434667bb150be9cdf5237e172c4198fe:$taskPath"
    $headBlob = git rev-parse "HEAD:$taskPath"
    $workBlob = git hash-object -- $taskPath
    if ($initialBlob -ne $headBlob -or $headBlob -ne $workBlob) { throw "Frozen input changed: $taskPath" }
    "FROZEN_MATCH=$taskPath $headBlob"
}
function Invoke-Step([int]$Number, [string[]]$CommandArguments) {
    if ((git rev-parse HEAD) -ne $expectedHead -or (git write-tree) -ne $expectedTree) { throw 'Validation identity changed' }
    if (@(git status --porcelain).Count -ne 0) { throw 'Dirty validation inputs' }
    "STEP=$Number/4"
    "START_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
    "COMMAND=cargo $($CommandArguments -join ' ')"
    & cargo @CommandArguments
    $stepExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    "STEP_EXIT_CODE=$stepExit"
    "END_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
    if ($stepExit -ne 0) { throw "Step $Number failed with exit $stepExit" }
}
$loopExit = 1
try {
    Invoke-Step 1 @('fmt', '--all', '--', '--check')
    Invoke-Step 2 @('clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets')
    Invoke-Step 3 @('build', '--workspace')
    Invoke-Step 4 @('test', '--workspace')
    $loopExit = 0
} catch {
    "VALIDATION_ERROR=$($_.Exception.Message)"
}
"FULL_LOOP_EXIT_CODE=$loopExit"
"FULL_LOOP_END_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
exit $loopExit
